agent_note:
Created the system_time Web adapter at backend/src/main/java/com/cmbchina/backend/system/adapter/web/SystemTimeController.java. The controller is @RestController with @RequiredArgsConstructor, class-level @RequestMapping("/api") plus @GetMapping("/hi") so the single route resolves exactly to GET /api/hi with no request parameters or body, injects the existing SystemTimeApplicationService and delegates directly to getCurrentTime(), wrapping the existing SystemTimeResponse in the template's com.cmbchina.backend.common.response.ResponseEntity via ResponseEntity.success(...) with no field mapping or business computation. No @RequireAnyResource or other authorization annotation was added because authentication.required=false and authorization_constraints is empty; the class exposes no upstream paths, touches no persistence or external client, and hardcodes no sample values. Java 8 compatible code with explicit imports.
